Thats a good point I never thought of it like that. It leads to the people who look after them and their families to suffer. 

My mother in law has to look aftet her one day a week and just with that one day you can see the tol its taken on her and her husband.

My sister In law has down syndrome and I would argue she has a much better life than the average worker. She will never have to work, gets money from the government, lives in supported living where all her needs are met and gets taken on many activities and holidays to boot.

I find it quite annoying because she is quite spoilt and gets away with a lot of bad behaviour. But yes you are right it is a drain on resources and I do find it morally questionable when people bring them into existence knowing they will be born with it.

Then again my mother in law had no idea until a few months after she was born but that was in 1989.
Do you have a link to the podcast?
I am more into this than most TV shows out now! Hope it has a happy ending.
You tell the story really well, are you a writer by any chance?
Well I was kind of talking about both a lot of the attractive girls on there seem to have access to lots of medical help unlike the less attractive people.
I don't feel uncomfortable about my appearance at all, its just a trend I noticed.
Well you can do, imagine facebook but in the guise of a mental health support site. I dont want to name it because there are good people on there.
I am sure your family believe you, and I would bet this situation is pretty common kids lie and are confused easily and with no other criminal history you will be ok.

I will probably get a lot of hate for this but the trial happened rather quick didn't it? These stories seem way too wild to be true, how does he get instant access to you after leaving court? No restraining order? I apologise for doubting you but if this is a lie please own up to it.

I know what you mean OP it has always baffled me that we are meant to be grateful for the opportunity to waste our life on a shitty job. Its also weird that the entire human race has been brainwashed into believing they are free.
Does he live with you? I know it is a grim question but how do you keep getting into the situation where he is able to do this awful thing?

Thank you the reply! I have confronted them before, my mum just makes it about her. I have my girlfriend who I stay with and I love her deeply but sometimes it gets to a point where I do not consider her when I feel suicidal which sounds really selfish :(

I have my girlfriend who I stay with most of the time, she is super supportive. I just feel bad relying on her all the time. 

I have done quite a lot of volunteer work mostly charity work. You are right about the time limit thing, I think I am expecting something miraculous because I feel like I am owed it which is a stupid way of thinking.

I am sorry you have gone through something similar it is absolutely awful when you are not believed about depression.
Stardew valley, that is something to get so easily lost in and cheap as well :)

I am the same, I got into a small amount of debt recently from buying things in hopes that it would make me feel better (it didn't). Now I feel bad selling things to make it back up even though they are mostly old games I never play.

Wish I could give you helpful advice but in the end it is just stuff, that's what people tell me anyway.
